items.alt: Hardik Singh drives India toward gold as teammates celebrate behind him, with the Malaysia goalkeeper in front and the Asian Games tally showing 85 medals.
Rain lashes the Sepang grid as a Verstappen-like Red Bull driver waits in his car while Hamilton-like Ferrari crew and other stopped cars sit under the safety car.
A Jack Dorsey caricature holds a messaging phone beside locked Indian app-store gates while phones continue linking through a dotted peer-to-peer network.
